# NearOffer

NearOffer is a local discovery platform for Faisalabad, Pakistan. It covers physical shops, venues and places across 24 categories, including local offers and wedding halls and marquees, plus a separate nearby masjid finder powered by Google Maps.

## How NearOffer works

- Customers browse categories and Faisalabad areas, review a published offer or place information, and then visit or contact the business directly.
- NearOffer does not process payments or provide delivery through the platform.
- Shops join through the Dukaan Portal registration form. The NearOffer team reviews submissions, and verification is based on phone or WhatsApp confirmation plus a matching shop photo and address.
- NearOffer ranking is never sold. Ranking is based on followers, genuine visits, ratings and new offers.

## Main pages

- Home: https://nearoffer.pages.dev/
- Articles and guides: https://nearoffer.pages.dev/articles/
- Wedding halls guide: https://nearoffer.pages.dev/articles/wedding-halls-in-faisalabad-booking-guide.html

## Help

For help, use the on-platform Help Chat on NearOffer and speak with the NearOffer team.
